items.title: Materials Area Entry
items.situation: A worker enters an active materials area where objects could fall, items could strike the feet, and equipment is moving.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for entry.

items.title: Loading Route
items.situation: A worker uses a route with overhead material handling, possible foot impact, and nearby moving equipment.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the route.

items.title: Grinding Preparation
items.situation: Powered grinding may send high-velocity particles and hot sparks toward a worker who also handles sharp material.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for grinding.

items.title: Cutting Bench
items.situation: A powered metal cut creates flying particles and sparks while sharp cut edges are handled.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for cutting.

items.title: Chemical Transfer
items.situation: Liquid chemical transfer may splash the eyes or face and contact the hands or feet.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for transfer.

items.title: Chemical Pouring
items.situation: A worker pours a liquid chemical with possible splash to the face and skin contact on the hands or feet.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for pouring.

items.title: Machine Operation
items.situation: A worker operates an industrial machine amid elevated noise and nearby moving equipment.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for operation.

items.title: Equipment Check
items.situation: An industrial machine runs loudly while other equipment moves near the worker's route.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the check.

items.title: Low-Voltage Panel Inspection
items.situation: Inspection requires an energized low-voltage panel to remain open. Exposed live components create contact risk, and a fault could release sparks or particles.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before inspection.

items.title: Electrical Diagnosis
items.situation: During diagnosis at a low-voltage panel that cannot yet be fully de-energized, a worker could contact energized parts or face a fault spark.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for diagnosis.

items.title: Maintenance Zone Entry
items.situation: A worker enters an area with potential falling objects, airborne particles, elevated noise, and moving equipment.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for entry.

items.title: Multi-Hazard Route
items.situation: Along a work route, materials may fall while airborne particles, high noise, and moving equipment are present.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the route.

items.title: Materials Dispatch Path
items.situation: At dispatch, a worker passes beneath handled materials, faces possible impact to the feet, and crosses a path used by moving equipment.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the path.

items.title: Active Storage Access
items.situation: Access to active storage involves overhead objects that might fall, items that may hit the feet, and equipment moving through the space.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for access.

items.title: Powered Edge Finishing
items.situation: Finishing a metal edge with a powered tool generates fast particles and hot sparks; the edge remains sharp to the touch.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for finishing.

items.title: Metal Section Trimming
items.situation: A worker trims metal with a powered cutter, exposing them to flying fragments, sparks, and sharp material contact.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for trimming.

items.title: Liquid Repackaging
items.situation: Repackaging a liquid chemical can splash the eyes or face and put the liquid in contact with hands or feet.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for repackaging.

items.title: Chemical Dispensing
items.situation: A worker dispenses a liquid chemical; splashes may reach the face and liquid may contact skin on the hands or feet.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for dispensing.

items.title: Industrial Line Operation
items.situation: While a worker runs an industrial machine, noise is elevated and mobile equipment passes close to the station.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for operation.

items.title: Machine-Area Rounds
items.situation: Routine rounds pass operating machinery with elevated noise and moving equipment nearby.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the rounds.

items.title: Energized Cabinet Troubleshooting
items.situation: Troubleshooting an energized low-voltage cabinet may expose a worker to live-component contact and electrical-fault sparks or particles.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE before troubleshooting.

items.title: Control Panel Diagnostics
items.situation: A diagnostic check requires a low-voltage panel to stay energized; exposed components and possible fault sparks remain hazards.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the check.

items.title: Shared Maintenance Bay
items.situation: A worker enters a shared maintenance bay with overhead falling-object potential, airborne particles, elevated noise, and moving equipment.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the bay.

items.title: Combined-Exposure Walkthrough
items.situation: A walkthrough involves possible falling objects, suspended airborne particles, loud machinery, and equipment moving through the area.
items.task: Identify the hazards and select PPE for the walkthrough.
